title: core.payment.voided v1
description: Published when CORE releases what is still held on a payment authorization, either on explicit request or because the hold expired. No ledger transaction is created. amount_minor is the amount released, which equals the whole authorization only when nothing was captured; captured_minor says how much had already moved and is therefore NOT released by this event.

amount_minor.description: The released remainder. Zero when the whole hold had already been captured.

reason.description: Free-text reason; "expired" is emitted by the expiry sweep.
